screening_class.description: ADVERSE_EVENT: any untoward medical occurrence in a person exposed, or possibly exposed, to a medicinal product, whether or not anyone links it to the product. SPECIAL_SITUATION: overdose, medication error, pregnancy or breastfeeding exposure, lack of efficacy, off-label use, misuse or occupational exposure without an adverse event. NO_PV_CONTENT: nothing about a person's health.

evidence.description: Short spans copied verbatim from the record that justify the class.
